problem_statement: Fix apply_changes() so it returns a deep-copied JSON document after applying every change in order. Paths are lists of string object keys or integer list indexes resolved against the current result. A set change replaces the value at its path (an empty path replaces the root), delete removes the existing member or item at a nonempty path, and insert resolves its path to a list and inserts its value at the requested index. Inputs are valid when each change is reached.
